usage_ledger.note: Returned-usage estimate, not account bill. Missing-usage transport failures are unknown and excluded from known cost, not asserted free.

selection.objective: tune verified all-task pooled F1, tie smaller K

system.objective: tune all-task pooled F1; ties preserve declared route-first/config order; no confirm selection

gate.objective: tune pooled all-task F1 of unverified Top5; ties lower z then p
gate.z_definition: (highest score - mean(other scores))/(population std(other scores)+1e-6); N0/1 z=0; empty pool returns empty
gate.p_definition: mean over top candidate of P_T1(example-predicted c1) * P_T2(example-predicted c2)
gate.gate_rule: accept task iff nonempty pool AND z >= threshold AND top1 ptrans >= threshold

selection.online_selection: This frozen main configuration only; no confirm winner selection

interpretation: All stage outputs retained; count-based failure decomposition is offline diagnosis, not a GT-based inference rule. Request slots differ from HTTP attempts; returned-usage failures are charged once.
